title: Install WSL Ubuntu (CN-friendly)
description: Windows in China? <0>wsl --install</0> talks to raw.githubusercontent.com which is blocked. This card sideloads an Ubuntu rootfs from a CN mirror and runs <1>wsl --import</1> instead.
downloadingRootfs: Downloading rootfs… (300+ MB, ~5 min on 1 MB/s)
doneMessage: Ubuntu installed and cicy-code downloaded. Run <0>wsl -d Ubuntu</0> and you should be set.
